login.title: Login
login.heading: Login
login.intro: Please sign in with your interface account.
login.error_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

home.intro: This is the SourceMod Web Admin. Use the menu on the left to manage the interface.
home.tile_users: Manage interface users and their permissions
home.tile_settings: Title, language and lists of the interface
home.owner_hint: As the owner you always have all permissions.
home.tile_sm_admins: SQL admins of the game servers with flags and groups
home.tile_sm_groups: Admin groups, immunity and group overrides
home.tile_servers: Game servers with live status, RCON and FTP
home.tile_games: Games with folder and icon for the server list
home.tile_sm_export: Create and upload the admin files for SourceMod
home.tile_sm_plugins: View, reload and unload the SourceMod plugins of the servers
home.tile_sm_extensions: View, reload and unload the SourceMod extensions of the servers

users.password_keep_hint: Leave empty to keep the current password.
users.delete_question: The user "{user}" will be deleted permanently.
users.account_readonly_hint: You may only change the permissions of this user.
users.owner_permissions_hint: The owner always has all permissions.
users.permissions_readonly_hint: You may not change the permissions of this user.
users.error_username: The username must be 2 to 30 characters long (letters, digits, space, _ . -).
users.error_email: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
users.error_password_length: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
users.error_email_taken: This e-mail address is already in use.

profile.username_hint: The username can be changed in the user management.
profile.password_changed: Your password has been changed. Other sessions have been signed out.

settings.site_subtitle_hint: Shown below the title. Leave empty to show none.
settings.default_language_hint: For the login page and users without their own choice.
settings.error_title: Please enter a title (up to 80 characters).
settings.error_subtitle: The subtitle may be up to 160 characters long.
settings.sm_per_page_hint: For the lists of admins, groups and overrides.
settings.error_users_per_page: Users per page must be between 5 and 200.
settings.error_sm_per_page: SourceMod entries per page must be between 5 and 200.
settings.server_query_timeout_hint: How long to wait for an answer (status, RCON, FTP).
settings.error_server_query_timeout: The timeout must be between 1 and 10 seconds.
settings.sql_admins_enabled: Manage SQL admins (admins, groups, overrides, export)
settings.sql_admins_enabled_hint: Switched off, the interface only manages plugins, extensions, servers and the console. Users keep the permission, but the pages are not available.

sm.tables_missing_warning: The SourceMod SQL admin tables are missing from the database. Without them, admins, groups, overrides and the export do not work. Missing:
sm.tables_missing_step_command: Run this admin command on a game server, in the server console or via RCON (the SourceMod plugin sql-admin-manager must be running):
sm.tables_missing_step_database: SourceMod creates the tables in the database from addons/sourcemod/configs/databases.cfg (entry "admins", otherwise "default"). It must be the same database this interface uses:
sm.tables_missing_step_recheck: Then reload this page with "Check again".
sm.tables_missing_alternative: Alternatively, import configs/sql-init-scripts/mysql/create_admins.sql from SourceMod into the database. If the tables are in another database or use another prefix, adjust sourcemod.database and sourcemod.prefix in config/config.php.
sm.error_charset: "{field}" contains characters the SourceMod table cannot store.
sm.error_control_chars: "{field}" must not contain control characters (e.g. line breaks).
sm.error_immunity: Immunity must be a whole number of 0 or more.
sm.error_override_name: The name must be 1 to 32 characters long and must not contain spaces.

flags.g: Change the map or major gameplay features
flags.l: Set a password on the server
flags.n: Change sv_cheats or use cheating commands

sm_admins.name: Name
sm_admins.name_hint: The admin's name in SourceMod, e.g. their player name.
sm_admins.identity_hint: Steam ID: STEAM_0:1:1234, [U:1:2469] or SteamID64. IP address: IPv4. Player name: always set a password.
sm_admins.immunity_hint: Protects against admins with lower immunity. Groups can raise it.
sm_admins.password_hint: Optional. The admin enters it in game via setinfo (key: PassInfoVar in core.cfg).
sm_admins.flags_hint: The admin's own flags. The flags of their groups are added.
sm_admins.groups_hint: The admin gets the flags, immunity and overrides of these groups.
sm_admins.delete_question: The admin "{name}" and their group memberships will be deleted permanently.
sm_admins.error_name: The name must be 1 to 65 characters long.
sm_admins.error_authtype: Please select how the admin authenticates.
sm_admins.error_identity_steam: Please enter a valid Steam ID (STEAM_0:1:1234, [U:1:2469] or SteamID64).
sm_admins.error_identity_ip: Please enter a valid IPv4 address.
sm_admins.error_identity_name: The player name must be 1 to 65 characters long.
sm_admins.error_identity_taken: An admin with this identity already exists.
sm_admins.error_password: The password must not be longer than 65 characters.

sm_groups.name: Name
sm_groups.immunity_hint: Members get at least this immunity.
sm_groups.immune_from_hint: Admins of these groups cannot target members of this group, regardless of immunity.
sm_groups.members_hint: Members are assigned on the admin.
sm_groups.overrides_hint: Allows or denies single commands for the members, regardless of their flags.
sm_groups.override_add_hint: If the override already exists, only its access changes.
sm_groups.delete_question: The group "{name}" and its memberships, immunities and overrides will be deleted permanently.
sm_groups.error_name: The name must be 1 to 120 characters long.
sm_groups.error_name_taken: A group with this name already exists.

sm_overrides.intro: Overrides define which flags a command or command group requires on the servers.
sm_overrides.name_hint: A command like sm_kick or the name of a command group.
sm_overrides.flags_hint: Replace the command's default flags. Admins with root (z) always have access.
sm_overrides.delete_question: The override "{name}" will be deleted permanently.

servers.intro: The status is queried directly from the server when the page opens.
servers.name: Name
servers.game_hint: Automatic: detected from the server's game folder.
servers.rcon_hint: The server's rcon_password; needed for RCON features.
servers.ftp_hint: For exporting the admin files to the server. Leave empty if the server has no FTP.
servers.ftp_path_hint: From the FTP login, e.g. cstrike/addons/sourcemod/configs.
servers.no_master_key: config/config.php has no valid security.master_key. Without it no passwords can be stored.
servers.test_hint: The test uses the stored data. Save changes first.
servers.test_rcon_no_sourcemod: Login successful, but SourceMod does not answer (sm version).
servers.test_decrypt_failed: The stored password cannot be decrypted (different master_key?). Please enter it again.
servers.test_ftp_connect: No connection to the FTP server.
servers.test_ftp_path: Logged in, but the path "{path}" does not exist.
servers.delete_question: The server "{name}" will be removed from the interface.
servers.error_name: The name must be 1 to 64 characters long.
servers.error_host: Please enter a valid IP address or host name.
servers.error_port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
servers.error_game: The selected game does not exist.
servers.error_address_taken: This server (address and port) already exists.
servers.error_ftp_host: Please enter a valid FTP host.
servers.error_ftp_port: The FTP port must be between 1 and 65535.
servers.error_password_length: Passwords must not be longer than 255 characters.
servers.error_master_key: Passwords cannot be stored without a valid security.master_key.

games.intro: The server list recognizes the game by the game folder the server reports.
games.name: Name
games.folder_hint: As reported by the server, e.g. cstrike, tf or csgo.
games.icon_hint: PNG, GIF, JPEG or WebP, at most 1 MB. Ideally square with a transparent background and at least {size} × {size} pixels (larger ones are scaled down). The icon is shown at 32 × 32 pixels. Good icons can be found e.g. on SteamGridDB.
games.error_name: The name must be 1 to 100 characters long.
games.error_folder: The game folder may only contain letters, digits, _ . - (up to 64 characters).
games.error_icon_upload: The icon could not be uploaded.
games.error_icon_size: The icon is too large (at most 1 MB).
games.error_icon_type: The icon must be a PNG, GIF, JPEG or WebP image.
games.error_icon_directory: The folder assets/uploads/games is not writable.

sm_export.info_admins_cfg: All admins with groups, flags, immunity and password (plugin admin-flatfile).
sm_export.info_admin_groups_cfg: All groups with flags, immunity, "immune from" and group overrides.
sm_export.info_admins_simple_ini: Short form: one line per admin. Only knows flags or one group; admins.cfg is complete.
sm_export.note_simple_groups: {count} admins are missing groups here (the file only knows flags or one group). admins.cfg contains them completely.
sm_export.note_simple_skipped: {count} admins are missing because their identity or password contains a quotation mark or line break.
sm_export.upload_hint: Overwrites the selected files in the servers' config path (FTP data under Servers).
sm_export.reload: Reload the admins via RCON afterwards (sm_reloadadmins)
sm_export.servers_without_ftp: {count} servers without FTP data are not shown.
sm_export.reload_no_rcon: No RCON password, admins not reloaded.
sm_export.error_selection: Please select at least one file and one server.
sm_export.error_ftp_write: The file could not be written (write permission in the path?).

sm_plugins.choose_hint: Choose a server above to see its plugins.
sm_plugins.no_servers: There is no server with an RCON password.
sm_plugins.error_details: The details could not be loaded.
sm_plugins.unload_question: "{name}" will be unloaded on {server}. SourceMod usually loads it again on the next map change.
sm_plugins.refresh_hint: sm plugins refresh: loads new and changed plugins from the server's plugin folder
sm_plugins.unloaded_hint: Unloaded here and not loaded again yet. SourceMod usually loads them again on the next map change.
sm_plugins.error_sm_missing: SourceMod is not running on the server.
sm_plugins.error_changed: The plugin list on the server has changed. Please try again.
sm_plugins.not_found: The plugin does not exist on the server (anymore).

sm_extensions.intro: The extensions are queried directly from the server via RCON once it is selected. Servers with an RCON password can be selected.
sm_extensions.choose_hint: Choose a server above to see its extensions.
sm_extensions.no_servers: There is no server with an RCON password.
sm_extensions.error_details: The details could not be loaded.

sm_extensions.unload_question: "{name}" will be unloaded on {server}. If plugins or other extensions depend on it, SourceMod lists them for confirmation first.

sm_extensions.unloaded_hint: Unloaded here and not loaded again yet.

sm_extensions.not_found: The extension does not exist on the server (anymore).

console.intro: Send commands to a server via RCON. The history is kept until you sign out. Servers with an RCON password can be selected.
console.no_servers: There is no server with an RCON password.
console.choose_hint: Choose a server above to open the console.
console.title: RCON console – {server}
console.offline_hint: The server is offline. Sending and the command buttons are locked until it can be reached again (checked every 15 seconds).
console.empty: No commands yet. The server's responses appear here.
console.error_invalid: The command may be at most {max} characters long and must not contain line breaks.
console.error_send: The command could not be sent.
console.truncated: … (truncated; the complete response was only shown right after sending)

install.title: Installation
install.intro: Checks the server, creates the database tables and the first user, and writes config/config.php.
install.requirements_failed: Required components are missing. Please install them and reload the page.
install.db_prefix_hint: For the tables of the interface, default smwa_, when taking over SMWA 2.x smwa3_.
install.sm_database_hint: Empty = the same database. Otherwise another database on the same server (same user).
install.owner_hint: The owner always has all permissions and can create further users.
install.error_db_host: Please enter a valid database host.
install.error_db_port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
install.error_db_name: The database name may only contain letters, digits, _ and - (up to 64 characters).
install.error_prefix: Prefixes and the SourceMod database may only contain letters, digits and _.
install.error_installed: The interface is already installed in this database with the prefix "{prefix}". Choose another prefix or update the existing installation.
install.error_unexpected: Unexpected error: {error}. Have all files of the new version been uploaded completely? Details are in the server's PHP error log.
install.error_unexpected_update: Unexpected error. Details are in the server's PHP error log.
install.done_text: The interface is installed. You can now sign in with the owner account.
install.done_config_manual: The folder config/ is not writable. Save the following content as config/config.php:
install.done_sm_missing: The SourceMod tables {tables} are missing. Create them with configs/sql-init-scripts/mysql/create_admins.sql from SourceMod or with sm_create_adm_tables on the game server.
install.done_delete: For security, delete the folder install/ now.
install.migrate_intro: Creates the new tables and takes over users with their permissions and passwords, servers, games and settings from an existing SMWA 2.x installation. The old SMWA is only read and stays unchanged.
install.old_database_hint: Empty = the same database as above. Otherwise another database on the same server (same user).
install.old_prefix: Table prefix of the old SMWA
install.old_prefix_hint_source: As $table in inc/config.php of the old SMWA.
install.old_prefix_hint: Default smwa. If the old SMWA is in the same database, the new prefix above needs a different name.
install.error_old_smwa: The prefix of the old SMWA may only contain letters, digits and _, its database only letters, digits, _ and -.
install.error_migrate_prefix: This database still contains tables of the old SMWA with the prefix "{prefix}" ({tables}). Please choose another prefix, e.g. smwa3_.
install.error_migrate_not_found: No SMWA 2.x was found in the database "{database}" (tables {prefix}users and {prefix}settings).
install.error_migrate_no_owner: The old SMWA has no owner (UserOwner = 1 in the user table).
install.error_migrate_no_key: The key for encrypting the RCON and FTP passwords is missing.
install.done_text_migrate: The interface is installed. Sign in with your existing username and password.
install.done_migrated_settings: {count} settings (entries per page, server query timeout)
install.done_migrated_no_password: Without a valid password, please set a new one under Users: {users}
install.done_migrated_hint: The permission "Console" did not exist in the old SMWA; grant it under Users if needed. The old SMWA and its tables stay unchanged and can be deleted once everything works.
install.update_intro: Brings the database up to date with the uploaded files. It is best to back up the database first.
install.update_versions: Installed: version {from_version}, database {from_db}. New: version {to_version}, database {to_db}.
install.update_login_hint: Sign in with the owner account to start.
install.update_error_connect: No connection to the database. Please check the credentials in config/config.php.
install.update_error_not_installed: The database from config/config.php contains no installation. To install again, delete config/config.php first.
install.update_error_newer: The database (version {from_db}) is newer than these files (database {to_db}). Please upload the matching version of the interface.
install.update_error_rate: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
install.update_error_login: Wrong username or password, or the account is not the owner.
install.update_done_text: The interface is now at version {to_version} (database {to_db}).
install.current_text: The interface is installed and up to date (version {to_version}, database {to_db}). To install again, delete config/config.php first.
